definitions.sample_weighted_mean_alignment: Mean over rounds of sum_k(n_k/sum_j n_j)*cos(delta_k,delta_global).
definitions.negative_update_fraction: Unweighted fraction of selected client updates with recorded cosine < 0.
definitions.sample_weighted_negative_fraction: Mean over rounds of the selected-sample weight carried by negative-cosine updates.
definitions.median_update_norm: Median L2 norm of local parameter update vectors; no normalization by local steps.
definitions.windows: First rounds 1-10 and last ten rounds of each completed run; first_40 supports matched E stress.
definitions.limits: Descriptive, same-run summaries. Global update contains each local update; cosine depends on client count. Norms depend on local steps. No causality/convergence/privacy claim.

source: Existing training JSONL only; no new training, test evaluation, or hyperparameter selection.
